text:
My weariness,
my anguish,
my joy,
my terror,
my humility,
all my nights,
my nostalgia for the year
nineteen thirty,
my common sense,
my rebellion.

My disdain,
my cruelty and my grief,
my abandonment,
my weeping,
my agony,
my inescapable and painful inheritance,
my suffering,
in the end,
my poor life.
